name: CONTENT-ARTICLE-WRITE-AND-EVENTS
status: candidate; local persistence and blog create implemented; consumer review and production transport pending

legacy.serialization: public Java Long values are decimal strings
legacy.retry: no automatic retry without a durable idempotency protocol

businessErrors.authOrResourceDenied: HTTP 401/403; dependency failure HTTP 503 with code 500
businessErrors.malformedJson: HTTP 400; no article business validation occurs
businessErrors.articleSystemFailure: HTTP 500, code 500 and generic message; no exception details

legacy.integerInput: JSON floating-point values for integer fields, including article id, categoryId and tags, are rejected with HTTP 400/code 400 before mutation. Integer JSON numbers and decimal strings remain accepted.

authorization.status: blog and admin article HTTP authorization implemented; real User/session integration pending
authorization.identity: verified principal supplies author and audit fields; client cannot set view count, revision or first-publication fact

candidateRules.transaction: All article and tag mutations acquire the database write-fence row before business locks in READ COMMITTED transactions. Incompatible or unspecified enclosing transaction isolation fails closed. Article, tag relations, revision, publication identity and immutable event commit or roll back together.
candidateRules.draft: Draft creation, draft editing, and deletion of never-published drafts emit no public event. Withdrawal and deletion of previously published articles emit no body.
candidateRules.publicationFact: For first publication the producer assigns the publicationFactId once and retains publishedAt. Legacy rows already known public may have unknown provenance. Editing or republishing them keeps the original null fields and cannot create a new ArticlePublished. Withdrawals and deletions emit body-free facts.
candidateRules.tombstone: withdrawal and deletion carry visibility and sourceRevision without body
candidateRules.redelivery: preserve original eventId, sourceRevision and payload
candidateRules.transport: Candidate local Relay is implemented and disabled by default; Stream/consumer integration is unverified. See relay-v0.1.json.
candidateRules.counter: CounterRevision is independent of content sourceRevision. Local ArticleCounterChanged v1 facts are in the separate counter stream; see counter-v0.1.json.
candidateRules.correlation: Validated X-Request-Id is an optional correlationId. New facts optionally capture traceparent only through the frozen EventTraceContext SDK; old JSON is not rewritten.
candidateRules.snapshot: Public facts contain category:{id,name}, active tags:[{id,name}]; soft-deleted tag relations remain for history but are omitted. viewCount and counterRevision come from the persisted row. Dates are ISO-8601 UTC.
candidateRules.bounds: title <=256 chars, content <=1000000 chars, summary <=1024 chars, thumbnail <=2048 chars, tags <=50 distinct positive IDs; Jackson document <=8000000 input units and string <=2000000 chars; serialized event <=8000000 UTF-8 bytes
candidateRules.outbox: content_article_event remains insert-only; each new fact atomically registers separate delivery state. No UPDATE/DELETE on immutable facts.
candidateRules.ddl: New installs use manual db/content-article-schema.sql; 02B installs require separately planned manual db/content-metadata-02c-upgrade.sql. Never auto-run; native MySQL migration unverified. Provision UTF8MB4 and UTC JDBC/session time zone.
candidateRules.eventSchemaVersion: New facts use candidate schemaVersion 2. PUBLIC payload includes isTop string 0/1; existing schemaVersion 1 rows remain unchanged. Consumer review and version compatibility required before transport.
candidateRules.metadataProjection: Tag rename or soft delete atomically records a job and one target per currently public associated article while holding the same fence. Disabled-by-default worker re-reads current state under that fence; public articles receive a new ArticleContentChanged v2 revision, drafts/withdrawn/deleted are skipped. No ArticlePublished is generated by compensation. Old events remain unchanged.

search: candidate schema v2 isTop and v1 compatibility

deliveryStatus.events: Immutable facts and a disabled-by-default candidate Relay are locally implemented; no native transport or downstream consumer integration verified.
deliveryStatus.visibility: G6 candidate machine-only current visibility; see snapshotContract.
deliveryStatus.snapshot: G6 candidate current batch, durable export and committed change feed; see snapshotContract.
deliveryStatus.ops: Internal producer summary/redelivery only; public aggregation and consumer operations remain future.
deliveryStatus.commentsCountingFrontend: Comment and counter facts can use the candidate Relay; actual consumers and broader frontend integration remain future.
deliveryStatus.validation: H2 transaction tests and local HTTP with signed synthetic keys and session substitute; native MySQL/Redis and real services unverified
deliveryStatus.articleWrite: Blog POST plus authorized admin create/edit/status/delete implemented; administrator can manage other authors, while blog author methods retain ownership checks.
